en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘The one who confesses with (ownership of) a child, then denies it, would be whipped the Penalty (Hadd), and the child would be enforced upon him’.
